item.title: Trump invokes executive privilege over Kennedy Center records
item.description: The White House has used executive privilege to prevent certain records of President Trump's communications from being shared with Rep. Joyce Beatty.

item.title: How Democratic activists posed as journalists to mislead the country
item.description: The media are embedded in the machinery itself, performing functions as important as those carried out by political operatives and intelligence officials.

item.title: HHS proposes allowing pharmacies to make peptides
item.description: The Department of Health and Human Services aims to let pharmacies compound certain peptides, according to a filing posted Thursday.

item.title: National Book Foundation honors book about white paint being racist
item.description: The author of Dead White says paint color is a matter of life and death and admits she has a genuine and visceral dislike of white paint.
